title: Album Cover with Mugshot Grid and Seated Figure
coreRelationships: The central seated figure is the dominant subject, framed by the grid of smaller portraits.
The grid of portraits creates a background texture and thematic context for the central figure.
The distressed texture overlays the entire image, unifying the diverse visual elements.
The typography at the bottom grounds the composition and conveys the album's message.
reuseFormula: Recreate the monochromatic blue-toned, distressed background with a grid of desaturated mugshot-style portraits. Place a central figure seated on a bucket, looking down, in white attire. Overlay bold, condensed white sans-serif typography for the main title at the bottom-center, flanked by lists of names in similar but smaller white sans-serif text. Include the '4P CMG' and 'PARENTAL ADVISORY' graphics in their specified positions.
